title: Announcements
description: Announcements from the program coordinators for your role — newest first.
descriptionAdmin: Draft announcements, choose the audience (roles) and publish. On publishing, active users in the selected roles receive an in-app notification.

empty.feedHint: When coordinators publish an announcement for your role, it will appear here and you will be notified.
empty.draftsHint: A new announcement is saved as a draft and only coordinators see it until it is published.
empty.publishedHint: Once you publish a draft, the selected roles will see it.

form.createDescription: The announcement is saved as a draft; press “Publish” when it is ready.
form.editDescription: Changes to a published announcement are visible immediately; no new notification is sent.
form.title: Title
form.bodyHint: Plain text; line breaks are kept.
form.audienceHint: Choose at least one role. Only the selected roles see the announcement and get notified.

confirm.publishBody: {count, plural, =0 {The announcement will be visible to the selected roles. No active users will be notified.} one {The announcement will be visible to the selected roles and # user will be notified.} other {The announcement will be visible to the selected roles and # users will be notified.}}
confirm.unpublishBody: Only coordinators will see the announcement. Notifications already sent are not withdrawn.
confirm.deleteBody: The announcement will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone, but it stays in the audit log.

errors.titleShort: The title must be at least 3 characters.
errors.titleLong: The title cannot be longer than 160 characters.
errors.bodyShort: The text must be at least 10 characters.
errors.bodyLong: The text cannot be longer than 4000 characters.
errors.notFound: Announcement not found — refresh the page.
errors.invalid: The data entered is not valid.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
